'''Interviews''' collected on this wiki are published player (and staff) interviews from SWCCG fan sites and magazines. The first block is the sixteen [[Trandosite]] interviews from 2000. Full text is on each player page under '''Interviews'''; this page is the index.

== DecipherCon 2000 Championship Match Interview ==

Post-match video of [[Matt Sokol]] and [[Yannick Lapointe]] after the [[2000 Decipher World Championship]] Final Confrontation. Derek Brooks provided the footage; brandon baity (NanashiStudios) posted it on 21 August 2018.

* [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ECUW3AIAH3A DecipherCon 2000 Championship Match Interview]<ref name="dcon-iv">[https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ECUW3AIAH3A DecipherCon 2000 Championship Match Interview], brandon baity (NanashiStudios) (21 August 2018). Preserved copy: [https://archive.org/details/youtube-ECUW3AIAH3A Internet Archive].</ref>
* Player pages: [[Matt Sokol#Interviews]] · [[Yannick Lapointe#Interviews]]
* Convention: [[DecipherCon 2000#Championship Match Interview]]

== Radio Free Decipher ==

Decipher's weekly RealAudio show, catalogued by Teltura (Ketura) on the LOTR-TCG Wiki and rehosted on YouTube by the Player's Council. Surviving episodes are preserved on Internet Archive as identifier <code>youtube-{id}</code>.

[[Carl Mike Hardy]] was a call-in guest on broadcast 9 (26 February 1999) with Chris Swearingen, [[Alex Alcalde]], and [[Guy Kargl]].<ref name="rfd-09">[https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=QU24jFxZsHM Radio Free Decipher 09], Player's Council (26 February 1999). Guests Chris Swearingen, [[Alex Alcalde]], Mike Hardy, and [[Guy Kargl]]. Preserved copy: [https://archive.org/details/youtube-QU24jFxZsHM Internet Archive].</ref>

* [[Radio Free Decipher]]
* [https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLYLMRQ0b_feAbpbNVQwlw3y8XH30ZQS1U RFD YouTube playlist]
